tests.name: Only Voyage is eligible; other Kindle models and desktop never attach hardware
First use inherits hardware without writing or assuming stock defaults
Pressure uses the native scalar ABI and its release threshold rule, then restores entry value
Both PagePress directions toggle together and separate original states survive restore
Failure on the second button write rolls back the first and leaves no saved override
Readback mismatch is failure and restores the old pressure
A failed rollback is explicit and cleanup retries partially written hardware
Haptic off uses the lock, gain zero remains a valid strength, and false baseline survives repeated edits
A locked keypad reports a reason without writes or saved settings
Gain parser rejects unknown firmware output and actual register readback detects ignored writes
Invalid persisted data and invalid changes cannot reach the hardware
Settings flush failure restores in-memory config disk config and hardware
A silent failed save is detected by reopening the settings file
Saved values reapply after restart and external hardware changes are preserved on suspend
Filemanager and reader owners share one lifecycle; only the last detach restores hardware
The actual Voyage attach factory shares one backend and detaches without leaked ownership
Unavailable hardware during suspend is reported and saved overrides can recover on resume
Non Voyage settings and global search do not offer PagePress
PagePress integrates with shared settings rendering and live device values
PagePress search covers sensitivity pressure vibration and Voyage
Direction control invokes the existing KOReader inversion event
Unavailable settings remain informative instead of throwing or displaying a fabricated state
Plugin suspend and resume restore and reapply hardware; stop restores entry values

results.hardware: ABI emulator; no real hardware writes
